companies.name: Wholesalers Manchester
companies.distributes: Branded sweets, chocolate, gummies, jelly sweets and snacks in bulk, from about 60 brands including Haribo, Trolli, Swizzels, Vidal, Bazooka, Anthon Berg, Lion, Millions, Sweetzone, Stockleys, Pells, Candycrave and Bebeto.
companies.channels_supplied: Shops, sweet shops, hamper makers, online retailers, mobile sellers, event organisers and schools, with trade prices shown ex VAT.
companies.fit_rationale: A trade sweets wholesaler whose own web shop lists bulk branded confectionery from around 60 brands at ex VAT trade prices for shops, so Diablo's sugar-free sweets and chocolate sit beside the brands it already sells. Scale: not shown on its website; one Greater Manchester site with click and collect and UK delivery in two days. Storage: B2B web shop with stock and trade prices, click and collect from its own site.
what_they_do_well: Carries around 60 confectionery brands, from Haribo and Trolli to Swizzels and Vidal, for trade buyers.

companies.name: M1 Confectioners Ltd
companies.distributes: Branded confectionery, chocolate, crisps and snacks, soft drinks and vending essentials, with Cadbury and Coca-Cola featured.
companies.channels_supplied: Independent retailers, vending operators, cafes, offices, hospitals and caterers across Belfast, Antrim, Down and the rest of Northern Ireland.
companies.fit_rationale: Northern Ireland's confectionery and beverage wholesaler, selling leading confectionery brands on to independent retailers and vending operators, which gives Diablo a route into NI corner shops. Scale: covers all of Northern Ireland (Bangor, Newry, Ballymena, Coleraine, Larne and more); nine staff and about 2 million pounds turnover; one site; also sells to the public. Storage: its own local warehouse with delivery to trade customers.
what_they_do_well: Family business trading since 2005, supplying confectionery, crisps and drinks across all of Northern Ireland.

companies.name: Vending Warehouse Ltd
companies.distributes: Branded chocolate, sweets, crisps and snacks and soft drinks in trade multipacks: Mars, Snickers, Twix, Bounty, Kit Kat, Kinder Bueno, Terry's, Maynards Bassetts, Rowntree's, McCoy's, Golden Wonder, Burts and Coca-Cola.
companies.channels_supplied: UK vending machine operators, micro markets, tuck shops, hospitality venues, events and gyms.
companies.fit_rationale: Supplies vending operators and micro markets nationwide with branded chocolate and sweets in trade packs, a route for Diablo bars and chocolate into many machines. Scale: not shown on its website; nationwide delivery in 1 to 2 working days; trading online since 2003; also open to retail buyers. Storage: B2B web shop listing stock in trade multipacks with nationwide dispatch.
what_they_do_well: Has supplied UK vending operators online since 2003, with nationwide delivery typically within one to two working days.
